propositions: Empty parsed Acceptance Criteria checkbox items must fail standalone clarity and plan-review P1 readiness

Unresolved sentinel assignments (TBD, TODO, FIXME, ???) in active execution sections must fail deterministic P1 readiness when they appear as values after colons, equals signs, or after the words 'is', 'remains', or 'left'
Sentinel matches must be suppressed when the same line contains removal or negation terms (no, zero, remove, delete, reject, forbid, must not, without)
Fenced code blocks and inline backtick code must not trigger sentinel detection rules
The shared plan-structure helper must preserve existing clarity score as compatibility coverage without changing ticket-type exemptions
Acceptance Criteria checkboxes with blank first lines and nonblank wrapped continuations must pass the nonempty-item validation rule
